item.title: Senior MP: Iran’s steadfastness leaves US in strategic dead end
item.description: Gorgan, IRNA — The chairman of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission of Iran’s Parliament says Iran’s resistance across multiple fronts has driven the US into a strategic dead end, adding that should the enemy persist in its miscalculations, Iran’s response will be more regret-inducing than ever before.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86320961/Senior-MP-Iran-s-steadfastness-leaves-US-in-strategic-dead-end

Gorgan, IRNA — The chairman of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission of Iran’s Parliament says Iran’s resistance across multiple fronts has driven the US into a strategic dead end, adding that should the enemy persist in its miscalculations, Iran’s response will be more regret-inducing than ever before.

item.title: US expected to end aggression, blockade if committed to diplomacy: Iran
item.description: New York, IRNA — Iran’s ambassador and chargé d’affaires to the United Nations says that if Washington is genuinely committed to a diplomatic solution, it must immediately and unconditionally end its aggression against Iran, lift the maritime blockade and other unlawful unilateral measures, and provide credible guarantees against renewed attacks.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86320910/US-expected-to-end-aggression-blockade-if-committed-to-diplomacy

New York, IRNA — Iran’s ambassador and chargé d’affaires to the United Nations says that if Washington is genuinely committed to a diplomatic solution, it must immediately and unconditionally end its aggression against Iran, lift the maritime blockade and other unlawful unilateral measures, and provide credible guarantees against renewed attacks.

item.title: In photos: Funeral procession for 110 unknown martyrs in Tehran
item.description: The funeral procession for 110 unknown martyrs of the Sacred Defense (a war imposed on Iran by the Iraqi Ba’ath regime from 1980 to 1988) kicked off in Tehran on February 13, 2026. This event coincided with the martyrdom anniversary of Hazrat Fatimah Zahra (SA) and was attended by Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86320487/In-photos-Funeral-procession-for-110-unknown-martyrs-in-Tehran

The funeral procession for 110 unknown martyrs of the Sacred Defense (a war imposed on Iran by the Iraqi Ba’ath regime from 1980 to 1988) kicked off in Tehran on February 13, 2026. This event coincided with the martyrdom anniversary of Hazrat Fatimah Zahra (SA) and was attended by Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.

item.title: Liquefied gas carrier explodes after striking naval mine in Strait of Hormuz: IRGC Navy
